subject: lego chess knight
concept: A LEGO model of a chess knight piece, built as a chunky stylised horse head and neck rising from a round chess-piece base, sitting stationary and proud like a display statuette.
features: round stepped base like a traditional chess piece
curved neck built from stacked bricks and slopes
stylised horse head with pointed ear bricks and a flowing mane ridge
simple round eye tile and short bar for the muzzle line
two-tone colour block: dark body with a lighter mane stripe
simplifications: Removed the traditional thin carved horse silhouette in favor of a chunky stacked-brick head and neck, since thin curved shapes can't stand freely.
Simplified the mane into a ridge of stacked plates instead of flowing carved strands.
Made the base a simple stepped cylinder of bricks instead of a lathe-turned chess base, since that's easy to build with round plates.
Kept the pose completely static and upright, matching a real chess piece's stillness so no balancing or action pose is needed.
Reduced facial detail to one eye tile and a bar-nose, keeping recognisability without needing printed or curved organic surfaces.
